- August includes a $1,000.00 UNITY ADS charge (Aug 20). I show it as a reclass to marketing UA, not as opex.
That leaves $96,968.21 of non-payroll opex for Jan-Sep.

Unity seats $850.00 (1/12 of the annual), Edgegap $600.00, Google Cloud $396.84, Sensor Tower $250.00 (Lite), Carta $230.00 (1/12), Deel $147.00, Gusto $142.00, QuickBooks $90.00, Zapier $73.50, ChatGPT $60.00 (2 seats), Canva $45.00, DocuSign $45.00, Webflow $29.00, Envato $27.04 (1/12), Cogency $25.00 (1/12), 1Password $23.97 (3 seats from Oct), Murf $22.00, Apple Developer $8.25 (1/12), Namecheap $7.20 (1/12).

Edgegap stays at $600 until Edgegap confirms the $420 plan.

- Midjourney, Sep 2, $60.00. Cancelled Jul 3 (MJ-77k2). The Aug 2 charge was refunded Aug 25, but they billed again on Sep 2.

- SavvyCal, Sep 11, $16.00. Account closed Sep 4.

Happy to walk through it at Friday's review.

Fred
